# Infogérance

> Infogérance (managed IT services) company based in Tunis, Tunisia. Specialised in infogérance informatique, systèmes & réseaux and cybersécurité for SMEs and large organisations: proactive monitoring, 24/7 support and security, cloud, outsourcing and IT audits. Projects delivered in Tunisia, France and Africa. Site available in French (default) and English (?lang=en).

## Key facts
- Location: 02 Rue Mahmoud Ghaznaoui, Tunis 1082, Tunisia
- Phone: +216 98 686 940 · Email: contact@next.tn
- Office hours: Monday–Friday 8:30–17:30; monitoring and support 24/7 for clients
- Managed-services centre: "Proximity" (Support, Analyzer, SOC, Backup, Network Protect, Office 365, Hosting, Disaster Recovery)
- Tools: Zabbix, Wazuh, Prometheus, Grafana (monitoring/security); MeshCentral, Ansible, TeamViewer, AnyDesk (remote admin); Nextcloud, OwnCloud, Office 365 (collaboration)
